impact: A huge AI server beat and backlog jump after Tuesday's chip selloff supports demand for memory and GPUs, a plus for MU, DRAM and SNXX and for NBIS's AI infrastructure peers; it contrasts with HPE's margin warning, so watch Dell's margins on the call.
summary: Dell reported record fiscal Q3 revenue of $54.9 billion, up 103% year over year and well above the roughly $49.3 billion expected, with non-GAAP EPS of $9.45, up 265%. AI-optimized server revenue was $22.0 billion, up 291%, and the Infrastructure Solutions Group made $42.0 billion. It booked $60.2 billion of AI orders and ended with a record $132.3 billion AI backlog. Dell raised full-year revenue guidance to $202 billion from $192 billion, guided Q4 to $56.3 billion, lifted its AI server revenue forecast to $78 billion from $74 billion (Reuters) and added a $25 billion buyback. Shares, down about 12% in Tuesday's session, rose roughly 2% to 5% after hours.
title: Dell Q3 revenue $54.9B, up 103%; AI backlog hits $132.3B, FY guide $202B
